snippet.title: Gonggi: Recess - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Out November 23, 2026 on Steam
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5475700/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=official-trailer-en

Recess. Five plastic stones on your desk. Toss, pick up and catch them with a physics-driven hand. Practice alone from Onesies to the Flip, or play your seatmate until the bell rings.

Generative AI was used to create in-game art assets and to translate the game's text. The music in the trailer was made with a paid Suno subscription.
